name: Demo K3: Type/Family Change Redline MEP Accessory
description: Exercise a type/family-change redline operation against a verified existing MEP accessory target: dry-run a compatible type change, apply it, prove readback, capture post-change evidence, then revert for repeat-safe live runs.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a copied model that can be closed without saving.
Provide an existing MEP accessory element id, its verified source family/type/category, and a compatible target type id or exact type name.
Use a low-risk target such as a damper or accessory in a copied sample model so the workflow can revert after verification.
success_criteria: /revit/change-element-type dry-run returns old and new type evidence for every requested accessory element.
Dry-run readback proves the requested source accessory family/type/category and original type.
/revit/change-element-type apply returns changed element ids covering every requested accessory.
A post-apply readback proves the accessory now has the requested target type id or name.
A post-change visual capture is produced before reverting.
The workflow reverts the accessory to its original type and readback proves restoration.
A type-change summary artifact is written.
failure_criteria: The dry-run cannot resolve the requested accessory target or compatible target type.
The dry-run source family/type/category does not match the reviewed accessory target.
The apply response omits any requested accessory element id.
Readback does not prove the requested target type after apply.
The revert dry-run/apply/readback omits any requested accessory id or fails to restore the original type.
grader_notes: This task is the accessory-specific type/family-change gate for high-volume Gemini damper/accessory rows.
Do not count a generic device type-change as accessory evidence unless source family/type/category grounding proves the target is the requested MEP accessory.
